name: io.github.davidmosiah/ninenine-mcp
description: Unofficial local-first 99 passenger MCP: 99Pop/99Moto estimates, ride history and tracking. Request-ride is fail-closed.

environmentVariables.name: NINENINE_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Personal 99 passenger ticket. Prefer `ninenine-mcp-unofficial auth --token` so this never sits in client config.

environmentVariables.name: NINENINE_ALLOW_MUTATIONS
environmentVariables.description: Set true to allow request-ride and cancel. Default false (never pays).

environmentVariables.name: NINENINE_PRIVACY_MODE
environmentVariables.description: summary | structured | raw. Default summary (status/ETA/category; redacts GPS).
